items.title: Matthew Maxey Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: And this I Got Five Long Years by James Russell and gang

ctx.x: Well, that's the man that's your foreman. In other words, that's your employer. That's the man who you workin' under you. That's the man that's over you.

And this I Got Five Long Years by James Russell and gang. Here on the record, he says, Who's that man on the big white horse? I don't know his name, but they call him boss. You know that? That would be your foreman then, huh?
